name: residential_newcomers_age
description: Tests 5 and 6 with a flat life-expectancy curve LE = 100 (property 0x6941A67F = (0, 100)(200, 100)), so no generational reset. Test 5: (100, 0, 0) -> (150, 0, 0), age 40: oldSum 100, 50 newcomers at the R$ new age 25 -> (100 x 40 + 50 x 25) / 150 = 5250 / 150 = 35. Test 6, the age quirk: (100, 0, 0) -> (50, 10, 0): the R$ level shrinks (no newcomers there) while 10 R$$ newcomers arrive at age 30; the old sum still counts all 100 old residents, so (100 x 40 + 10 x 30) / 60 = 4300 / 60 = 71 (truncated).
